Criteria for Approval:
Approval Duration: 6 months initial; 1 year renewal

• Diagnosis of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV); AND
• Current use of antiretroviral therapy for the treatment of HIV; AND
• Active infection has been ruled out via fecal collection and microbiologic culture; AND
• Trial and failure of 2 preferred agents.

Renewal Criteria:
• Documented reduction in the frequency and quantity of liquid stool volume for the previous 6 months; AND
• Documented monitoring/follow-up plan that includes re-culture for microbiologic agents if breakthrough diarrhea occurs while on crofelemer therapy.

Age Limit: ≥ 18 years
Quantity Limit: 2 per day
